reason: A dsh agent preset that reduces prompt overhead by disabling selected orchestration tools and includes a local audit command for analyzing session token and cost usage.

summaries.zh: 这是一个用于 dsh 的精简智能体预设，通过停用部分工作流和后台工具来减少提示词开销，并提供本地会话成本审计命令。
summaries.en: A dsh agent preset that reduces prompt overhead by disabling selected workflow and background tools and provides a local command to audit session token and cost usage.

capabilities: Adds a dsh agent preset for web and headless profiles
Disables selected workflow, subagent, goal, jobs, and ralph tools
Provides a local audit command for session token and cost analysis
Copies and modifies the standard preset through dsh authoring APIs
